cause_prs.author: k50112113
cause_prs.title: [Triton/Gluon] [Config] gfx950: tune gemm_a16w16 configs for DeepSeek-V4 GEMMs (K=7168)

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
`test_bitwise_against_aiter_and_separate_fake_quant` fails `torch.equal(plain, ref)` on both attempts, on shard 0 of all 3 lanes with the aiter override.
The sister run AA has the same sglang SHA and the default aiter `285579b6`, and passes all 8 tests in the file.
The test passed in all 4 earlier Scout runs; the last was Oct 17.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: aiter [#6601](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6601) ([`2fa9f7e7`](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/commit/2fa9f7e7cc00427d759a638bbf4ca296ffbf37a9)) added a gfx950 `BATCHED_GEMM-A16W16-B=2-N=1024-K=4096.json`. Its `M_LEQ_64` entry sets `NUM_KSPLIT: 4`, and that is exactly the shape of the test's reference call. aiter now sums K as 4 fp32 partials, while sglang's single-launch kernel sums K in order, so the results no longer match bit for bit.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: not reproduced locally. Serving uses this aiter kernel only when `SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_BATCHED_GEMM=1`, which is off by default.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. Searched `test_fp8_grid_producers`, `batched_gemm_bf16_fp8_grid`, `fp8_grid aiter`.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: on MI35x with aiter `26f4f1fb`, check that `_get_config(64, 1024, 4096, B=2)` returns `NUM_KSPLIT=4`. Then rerun the test with the B=2 JSON moved aside, or with the test's aiter reference pinned to `NUM_KSPLIT=1`.
